snippet.title: PLACE - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Demo version available
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3823800/PLACE

You are a random person trapped in an empty concrete room under the watchful eye of a camera. The only way out is to risk pressing a forbidden button, which will trigger the appearance of more buttons. Each press brings you closer to either escape or death.
